gen-fs-pramukh-rounded-gf-major-mono-dis: Major Mono Display reads like neon glass, each letter spaced well apart. Pramukh Rounded bunches its friendly glyphs tight, so the monospace text unfolds slowly, every character wrapped in generous sidebearings.
gen-fs-red-hat-display-gf-marcellus-sc: Marcellus SC reads dignified and literary, its lowercase standing tall like cast iron capitals. But Red Hat Display does its best work with a marker-like constant line, leaving daylight inside every curve.
gen-fs-red-hat-display-gf-scope-one: Bold and contemporary, Red Hat Display draws a marker line with daylight inside every curve. Scope One follows with stubby ascenders, a big x-height and spilling counters, giving the classic serif a traditional, refined footing under that confident heading.
gen-fs-red-hat-display-gf-slabo-13px: Bold marker-like lines up top, bookish serif letters below. Red Hat Display keeps a constant width through every curve, while Slabo 13px opens large counters in its tall a, e and s.
gen-gf-balsamiq-sans-gf-ibm-plex-sans-th: IBM Plex Sans Thai Looped leaves its curves open at the ends. Balsamiq Sans draws bold, expressive strokes of one stubborn thickness, so the more varied sans below feels like a quiet reply.
gen-gf-balsamiq-sans-gf-noto-sans-canadi: Noto Sans Canadian Aboriginal keeps every curve end open and contemporary. Noto Sans Canadian Aboriginal, a plain sans, is the quiet half, so Balsamiq Sans and its bold, round, unswelling outlines get all the personality.
gen-gf-bellota-text-gf-istok-web: Commanding, distinctive shapes from Bellota Text, with open curves and a monoweight stroke that never shades. Istok Web, a modern sans with approachable rounded letters, keeps a long passage flowing smoothly.
